jobs.title: Cyber Security Engineer (agentic)
jobs.description: Company: P.I.V.O.T Security Location: On-site, (New Delhi, Dehradun or Mumbai office) Experience: 1 to 3 years in offensive security development About Company: P.I.V.O.T Security is a fast-growing leader at the forefront of offensive security. We protect organisations against highly sophisticated cyber threats through our services and offensive security platforms, finding and fixing the gaps attackers would exploit before they do. Our products cover browser security and data loss prevention, phishing simulation and awareness training, mailbox hardening, breach and attack simulation, application and API security testing, dark web threat intelligence, and an offensive cyber range for hands-on training. Research drives what we build. Our team studies live attacker tradecraft, publishes original research, has disclosed vulnerabilities to major vendors, and presented at international security conferences like Microsoft's BlueHat Asia. We also contribute to the AI and LLM security community through research on agentic model and MCP bypass techniques, and we are a research partner to academic institutions including IIT Bombay and UPES. That work becomes product capability, and our red team, penetration testing, DFIR and compliance services feed the same techniques back into the platforms. We are a DPIIT-recognised startup and serve banks, government bodies, manufacturers and technology companies in India, with GCC and international reach through partner brands. About the Role: We are looking for an Offensive Security Engineer who writes production-quality code and wants to apply it to offensive security. You will join our product engineering team and work hands-on across our full product portfolio: STEP (our breach and attack simulation platform), WARUS (our agentic application security platform), Enforce (our browser security platform), Lock-E for enterprise email hardening, Phish-E and PhishIQ for phishing simulation and awareness, BreachedB4 for dark web threat intelligence and the PIVOT Labs cyber range. You will build and extend cyber kill chain and adversary emulation capabilities alongside our red team and DFIR practitioners, and you are expected to move between products as the roadmap and client needs demand rather than owning a single platform. This is a developer role first. You will design, build, test and ship software that our security teams and clients use, own delivery for the components you build, and see how your work performs against real environments. Key Responsibilities: Cross-product development: build and extend features across our full product portfolio - STEP (breach and attack simulation), WARUS (SAST and DAST), Enforce (browser security), Lock-E (email hardening), Phish-E and PhishIQ (phishing simulation and awareness), BreachedB4 (threat intelligence) and PIVOT Labs (training range), moving between products as priorities shift Product and kill chain development: build and extend product features and cyber kill chain and adver

jobs.title: Junior GRC, IT/OT & Product Cybersecurity Consultant
jobs.description: About Us We are the independent expert in assurance and risk management. Driven by our purpose, to safeguard life, property, and the environment, we empower our customers and their stakeholders with facts and reliable insights so that critical decisions can be made with confidence. As a trusted voice for many of the world’s most successful organizations, we use our knowledge to advance safety and performance, set industry benchmarks, and inspire and invent solutions to tackle global transformations. About The Role Interested in cybersecurity beyond traditional IT? Cybersecurity is no longer just about protecting IT systems. Industrial processes, electricity networks and connected products are becoming increasingly dependent on secure technology. At DNV Cyber, we are expanding our work within Operational Technology (OT) and product cybersecurity, and we are looking for a junior consultant who wants to grow with us. You do not need to be an expert. We are looking for someone with a good technical foundation, curiosity and a genuine interest in understanding how technology, security and business come together. What you will do? You will work alongside experienced consultants on assignments involving industrial environments, connected products and cybersecurity. Depending on your background and experience, your work may include: Supporting cybersecurity risk assessments and security reviews. Helping clients understand and address cybersecurity requirements. Participating in OT and product cybersecurity advisory assignments. Supporting work related to cybersecurity standards and regulations, including IEC 62443 and the EU Cyber Resilience Act. Developing documentation, analysis and recommendations for clients. Learning from experienced colleagues and gradually taking on greater responsibility. You will have the opportunity to develop both your technical understanding and your consulting skills through real client assignments. #DNVCyber What we offer Why join us? You will become part of a consulting team building its capabilities in GRC, OT and product cybersecurity. You will work with experienced colleagues, gain exposure to different industries and develop practical experience in an area of growing importance. Our ambition is to give you the opportunity to grow into a skilled and independent consultant while contributing to the development of our services and our team. If you are curious about cybersecurity and want to work with technology that matters to businesses and society, we would like to hear from you! At DNV Cyber, we are passionate about cybersecurity and proud of the impact our work has on society. Through knowledge sharing, collaboration and challenging client projects, you will have opportunities to learn and develop professionally. You will join around 500 colleagues who share your passion for cybersecurity and be part of a strong professional community where you can learn from experienced specialists across the field. Join us and grow
